thread:
Alex Kim: Quick reminder — changelog cutoff is 18:00 PT today. We still have a handful of open PRs on sampleapps/quickstarts that need owners or they'll miss the cut. List below, pls claim:
- sampleapp-node: PR #842 (CI flaky)
- quickstart-python-web: PR #691 (docs + test)
- sampleflow-js: PR #77 (needs small API change)

Ping @Samir, @Luca for test infra / runtime fixes. :eyes:

Maria Chen: I'm on #691, failing test is `test_oauth_flow` — looks like a token rotation timing issue in CI. I can try a flaky-ignore patch but would prefer a proper fix. ETA 2-3h.

Samir Patel: I'll look at #842 now, failing on a race in the DB fixture. If I can't fix quickly, propose we back out the new dependency and ship the rest.

Luca Martinez: Re: #77, small API change touches runtime shim. I can do the shim patch but need a devex review for compatibility. @Ryan, can you eyeball the contract doc?

Ryan O'Neill: Sure, dropping in a quick review. Link me the diff.

Alex Kim: Thanks. If any PR can't be fixed before cutoff we'll mark as post-cut changelog and schedule a canary for next patch. Please add a short note in the PR why it missed the cutoff.

devex-bot: CI status: sampleapp-node/#842 failing — 3 tests failing. quickstart-python-web/#691 flaky — 1 test failing. sampleflow-js/#77 pending review. (automated)

Maria Chen: Quick note — I can do a hotfix to skip the timing-sensitive assertion and open a follow-up issue to track the root cause. Vote :+1: to skip now?

Samir Patel: :+1: for skip and issue. We shouldn't block the release on flaky infra.

Luca Martinez: :+1: I'll prepare the shim patch and include compatibility tests, but if it needs deeper runtime work we can ship without it and roll forward.

Alex Kim: OK. Owners: Maria -> #691, Samir -> #842, Luca -> #77 (devex review requested from Ryan). If you update status in the PR comment with 'claimed by <name>' I'll reconcile the changelog.

Ryan O'Neill: Reviewing #77 now. If it's purely backward-compatible I'll approve ASAP. If not, we'll defer.

Samir Patel: Small update — I pushed a test-fix branch, CI passing locally, pushing to run full pipeline. Will update PR comment in 10m.

Maria Chen: Hotfix PR opened: #692 — skips flaky assertion and references issue #1589. CI queued.

devex-bot: CI status update: quickstart-python-web/#692 queued, sampleapp-node/#842 pipeline running.

Alex Kim: Great. Last ask: docs team, please make a 1-line note in the release notes for any skipped items. @Ryan can you confirm docs slot?

Ryan O'Neill: Yep, I'll add a 'Known issues' bullet for the skipped test and link follow-ups.

Alex Kim: Thanks everyone — will assemble changelog and cut at 18:00 PT unless something else pops. :shipit: 

Luca Martinez: Ping if you need me to pair on review after Ryan's pass.

Samir Patel: Pipeline green on #842, merging now.

Maria Chen: CI green on hotfix, merging in 2m.

Alex Kim: Cut done — changelog published, marking resolved items. If anything slipped in, flag a post-cut patch.

Ryan O'Neill: Docs updated and released with changelog.

Alex Kim: cheers, closing thread.
